artist_statement.text:
Nowhere To Esc.


An Esc key is supposed to offer a way out. It means cancel, leave, stop, go back. But here, a small ant is trapped inside it, turning the key from a symbol of escape into a tiny prison. The exit exists, but it cannot be used.


The image takes something familiar from the digital world and makes it physical. The ant becomes a stand-in for anyone caught inside a system that still shows the language of freedom while removing the reality of it. You can press the button, but nothing changes. The choice is visible. The escape is withheld.


Nowhere To Esc is about being watched, guided, blocked, and trapped inside systems that offer choices without offering real freedom.


Shot on Iphone 17 Pro Max

Processed in Lightroom / Photoshop


Location: Montreal, Canada

Shot on: May 18, 2026


I, Arsonic,  declare that if this piece is selected and purchased by the 6529 Network Museum, this work will be released under CC0 and I have full rights to make that release and a full consent from the ant.


P.S. No ants were harmed during this shoot. It escaped the studio.
